items.title: Ted Piltzecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 10, 2019
items.q: This is like Mozart, I mean this guy has some kind of processing power that’s really magnificent.

ctx.x: This is by a European musician, Sven Bearsted, and it’s a whole book about storytelling in jazz improvisation.

Oh. That’s great, a great way to look at it, probably the most viable way to look at it. It’s so easy to get consumed with negotiating the right chord, the right changes, the right scale for this — you have to go through all that stuff. But ultimately, as I was saying earlier today, it’s about relating and telling a story, and a story is a narrative, and it’s the narrative that always captures our attention more than information, more than basic information. It’s the story that will capture your attention. All…
